## 5.2 ruff, the formatter and the linter, in the group lint {#step-05.2}

[ruff](https://docs.astral.sh/ruff/) is a formatter and a linter in one tool, written in Rust by Astral, the makers
of uv. `ruff format` writes the code in the layout of black, the formatter of most Python projects. `ruff check`
checks the rules of flake8 and of many other linters, and can fix some of them. It takes the place of both black and
flake8, and runs much faster.

ruff checks the code, and the server does not need it to run. So ruff goes into a group of its own, `lint`.

This change came from running `uv add --group lint ruff`.

```bash
uv run ruff --version
```

uv prints the version of ruff, `ruff 0.17.1` on the day of the class.

### What changed {#step-05.2-what-changed-182c57}

- <a id="step-05.2-pyproject.toml-5d07e7"></a>`pyproject.toml`: ruff, in the group `lint`. 3 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group lint ruff`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/9662828462ba2a21ca04a79c412e83ac070767f6/pyproject.toml){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}
  - look at `"ruff>=0.17.1",`
- <a id="step-05.2-uv.lock-8356d8"></a>`uv.lock`: the exact version of ruff. 29 lines added. It comes from `uv add --group lint ruff`. [The file](https://github.com/rahuldave/cheesecracker/blob/9662828462ba2a21ca04a79c412e83ac070767f6/uv.lock){.btn .btn-sm .btn-secondary}

+lint = [
